fields.statement: At 1648261d, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(run-start|run-start-queue|daemon-settings|daemon-pause|daemon-event-hook|daemon-repo-session|stage-autonomy|testscript-root|runs-need-root)$' passed every script. git diff 85470cb5^..1648261d shows those seven scripts unedited, while runs-need-root (85470cb5) is in force. The Setup in cmd/rhiza/main_test.go writes $WORK/rhiza.toml registering project repo at $WORK/repo and sets $NOROOT to a temp folder outside any root, per decision m29-test-root-per-script. In the new testscript-root.txtar, rhiza root show in $WORK/repo prints root: and project: repo; in $NOROOT it exits non-zero with 'not inside a Rhiza root' and next: rhiza root init. root-daemon-lock belongs to change set 01M6RN3RCGAZ9RNTWTZPKFM61M and is not built at this commit, so the daemon scripts were checked under the root without it.
